subject: Anaconda overwrites R on PATH (Mac OS X)

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Anaconda overwrites R on PATH (Mac OS X)
parts:
I tried to get Jupyter installed, which wasn't working
with R out of the box, so I followed instructions to install
R through Anaconda, and then Jupyter worked, but it hosed
my basic R install by overwriting my PATH:

~/stan-dev/example-models(master)$ which R
/Users/carp/anaconda/bin/R

Then when I updated R to 3.3.2, the R GUI picked it
up, but now the terminal's launching the Anaconda version.
Initially, it told me that rstan wasn't installed, which
gave me the tipoff there was a problem with the install.

- Bob
